subject: LedgerWorks billing platform renewal and NetSuite migration coordination
messages:
From: Sofia Morales <sofia@ledgerworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LedgerWorks annual renewal — quote and new integration fee

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Hope you're both well. This is a heads-up that your LedgerWorks subscription is set to auto-renew on 2026-08-01. Attached is the renewal_quote_v2.pdf with the new line items — we've rolled the new API integration fee into year 1 to cover our enhanced NetSuite connector.

Summary (high level):
- List price: $120k/year (up from $98k) — includes LedgerWorks core + 100k invoices/mo
- One-time integration fee (year 1): $15k for NetSuite connector onboarding
- Standard SLA (99.5%), SOC2 available on request

If you'd like, I can hold the auto-renew for 10 business days while you review. Let me know any questions or if you want us to coordinate a short call to walk through the connector capabilities.

Thanks,
Sofia Morales
Account Manager, LedgerWorks
sofia@ledgerworks.com

Attachment: renewal_quote_v2.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LedgerWorks annual renewal — quote and new integration fee

Sofia — thanks for the heads-up and the quote. A couple quick items from our side while we review internally: 

1) Please pause the auto-renew until we confirm (we will respond formally within 10 business days).
2) We are planning a NetSuite migration in Q4 (internal timeline) — can you confirm the migration connector will work with NetSuite 2024 R2 and whether the integration fee is mandatory or optional?
3) We need more granularity on the pricing change (line-by-line) and any seats/event-based traps.

High-level ask: if LedgerWorks can provide temporary price protection to the existing rate through our migration (90 days after go-live), that would make the transition budgetable for our finance team and greatly increase the chance we proceed with a longer-term renewal.

Looping in Marcus (tech) and Laura (finops) so we can align on acceptance criteria.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: LedgerWorks renewal — negotiation points

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding Sofia's note with my initial thoughts. Proposed negotiating priorities (short and actionable):

- Push back on the integration fee: request it to be credited if we sign a 12mo commitment.
- Price protection: freeze current price for 90 days post-migration or offer staged ramp (we should accept a small increase but not full list).
- SLAs & audit: require SOC2 Type II report and 12 months of invoice-level audit logs retained for 7 years (finance requirement).
- API: minimum API rate limits and guaranteed migration support windows (3 day overlap support).

If legal (Rachel) could review and flag anything risky in the contract terms we can include a redline. Marcus — please confirm whether the connector supports NetSuite 2024 R2.

Laura
Director, FinOps
Redwood Inference

---
On Mon, Jul 20, 2026 at 09:12 Sofia Morales <sofia@ledgerworks.com> wrote:
> (original message and quote attached)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LedgerWorks annual renewal — quote and new integration fee

Sofia — thanks for the quick response. We discussed internally and here is a consolidated counterproposal: 

Counterproposal (high level):
- 12 month renewal starting on date of executed agreement; list price to be $105k/year (midway between) with the following condition: price protection at the current rate for 90 days after our NetSuite go-live.
- Integration fee: waive the $15k fee if we commit to 12 months and put a $7.5k credit toward migration assistance (applied in invoice).
- API & integration: confirm compatibility with NetSuite 2024 R2, SSO support (SAML), and API rate limit of at least 400 requests/min for invoice sync.
- Security/compliance: provide SOC2 Type II report and 7-year invoice-level audit exports on request.
- Contract: we will send a redline with two small changes (limitation of liability cap and data deletion window).

Attached: redlined_contract_v1.docx (for your legal). We'd like to keep the contract finalization timeline under 2 weeks if possible — happy to take a short call next week to close.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redlined_contract_v1.docx
From: Sofia Morales <sofia@ledgerworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: billing-ops@ledgerworks.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LedgerWorks annual renewal — quote and new integration fee

Hi Marissa — appreciate the clear counter. Good news: the NetSuite connector supports 2024 R2 and SAML for SSO. Our finance lead approved a compromise:

- We can set the annual fee at $108k/year with the 90-day price protection you requested.
- We will provide a $10k migration credit (one-time) instead of waiving the full integration fee.
- SOC2 Type II report: available (I attached migration_credit_offer.pdf).
- We prepared an updated DocuSign package with the terms reflected here: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/to/agreement/LW-5678

If these terms are acceptable, we can execute and schedule a migration kickoff within 2 weeks of signature.

Best,
Sofia Morales
Account Manager, LedgerWorks
Attachment: migration_credit_offer.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LedgerWorks contract — legal redline notes

Hi all — quick legal read of the updated package: two small asks before we sign.

1) Limitation of liability: move from a per-event cap to a 12-month aggregate cap equal to 3x annual fees (protects us for billing regressions).
2) Data deletion & export: require an export-ready invoice-level CSV within 30 days of termination and a written certification of deletion within 60 days.

If LedgerWorks accepts those two points, I'm comfortable with execution. Attached my redline for reference.

Rachel Kim
Staff Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: legal_redline.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final approval: LedgerWorks agreement (PO 5678)

Sofia — thanks for working through this. We reviewed LedgerWorks' updated terms and Rachel's legal redline. We accept the commercial terms you outlined (annual fee $108k, $10k migration credit, 90-day price protection) provided LedgerWorks accepts legal's two redline items. Once you confirm acceptance in DocuSign we will sign and issue our PO.

Please confirm the following next steps:
- Send executed agreement via DocuSign and updated invoice addressed to Redwood Inference (we will raise PO 5678 upon receiving final DocuSign).
- Proposed migration kickoff window: week of 2026-08-17 (3 working days of dedicated onboarding support).
- Provide SOC2 Type II report link and API rate-limit SLA statement (billing-ops contact).

Attached: PO_5678.pdf (pre-filled for our internal PO once agreement is received).

If we can get the signed agreement and invoice by EOD 2026-08-05, we'll be able to keep the migration timeline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO_5678.pdf
